privacy.metaDescription: What data the tokenhood.kosm.io website processes, why, and how to exercise your rights.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Tokenhood is a commons started by Kosmio. This page explains what data the tokenhood.kosm.io website processes, why, and how to exercise your rights.

sections.title: Data controller
paragraphs: Kosmio SAS, Villa 8, 301 rue du Romarin, 34160 Castries, France. Contact: contact@kosm.io.

sections.title: Data collected
paragraphs: If you fill in the “Join the bootstrap” form: your email address and the role or roles you tick. Nothing else.
The website sets no cookies and uses no audience measurement tool. Typefaces are served by our own server: displaying a page sends no request to any third party.

sections.title: Purpose and legal basis
paragraphs: Your address is only used to notify you when the bootstrap opens and about the steps that concern you. Processing is based on your consent, which you confirm through the link sent by email and may withdraw at any time.

sections.title: Recipients
paragraphs: Only the team running Tokenhood at Kosmio has access to the list. It is hosted by Brevo (Sendinblue SAS, France), which sends the emails on our behalf from servers located in the European Union. The website is hosted by OVH SAS (France). No data is sold or transferred.

sections.title: Retention
paragraphs: Until you unsubscribe, and at most three years after our last exchange. Every email contains an unsubscribe link.

sections.title: Technical logs
paragraphs: The website keeps no visit log. Only server errors are logged, for diagnosis; they may contain the IP address of the request involved.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, object to, restrict and port your data. Write to contact@kosm.io. If you believe your rights are not respected, you can lodge a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority: https://www.cnil.fr.
